title: Full Rail Safety National Law applied (Western Australia)
summary: From 1 October 2024 Western Australia applied the Rail Safety National Law in full. Since 2015 it had used mirror legislation that locked in a 2015 local version of the national law, so later national amendments did not apply in the state.

instruments.title: Rail Safety National Law (WA) Act 2015 and its 2024 amendments
instruments.provisions: applies the Rail Safety National Law in Western Australia

commenced.what: Full application of the national law commenced

direction_rationale: ONRSR said the change brings Western Australia into line with all other states and territories, ensuring greater consistency and letting rail operators benefit from amendments made since 2015.

verified.notes: Date from ONRSR's news item of 26 September 2024. The amending Act's title was not checked on the WA register, whose pages load by script.

assessment.summary: Western Australia replaced a frozen 2015 copy of the national rail safety law with the current national law, so its rail operators follow the same rules as operators elsewhere.

marks.reason: Rail safety rules in WA now match the other states'.
Operators in several states no longer track a separate WA version of the law.
